summary: Iter61 — Frasberg Engine Runtime (44 TS engines + 6 systems) wired into backend & frontend. Backend: 17/17 pytest green sequentially (parallel xdist shows one race between TestPolicyGovernance.test_policy_blocks_action and TestExecute.test_continuity_persist_and_delete because both use owner=admin:...+engine=mind; tests pass fine in sequence — isolation nit, not a product bug). Covered: /api/engines/runtime auth (anon 401, non-admin 403, admin 200, platform-key 200, count=44 total=50 systems=6); POST /engines/{mind,logic}/execute returns 'Mind processed: hello' / 'Logic processed: abc' with requestId+coverage; continuity 'w-test-*' persists runs>=1 and DELETE returns {deleted}; POST /engines/chain with X-Frasberg-Key works; POST /engines/flow {domain:'structure'} returns exactly 10 stages identity..structure with awareness_valid=true; unknown domain 404; PUT /engines/policy {actions:['execute:mind']} then execute mind → 403 (reset to [] restores 200); PUT /engines/governance scope=global as admin blocks platform-key execute 403; platform-key PUT scope=global → 403 'Only admins can set global governance'; diagnostics counters, identity nodes, /engines/rules 401 anon/200 admin. Frontend: /engines → 301 to /status (SPA Navigate replace), Footer has no footer-engines-link, /models has no engine-runtime, /developers (ApiDocs gate) has no engines link; /status as admin shows engine-runtime-grid, engine-open-mind opens engine-run-panel, run yields engine-run-request-id with 'Enforced · request <uuid> · continuity w-ui-test'; engine-chain-add-logic + engine-chain-run present; engine-systems panel with engine-flow-run (fills engine-flow-output), engine-policy-input/save, engine-gov-owner-input, engine-gov-global-input, engine-diag-engine, engine-identity all mount. Regression: /, /create, title='Frasberg Creator | …' OK. Policy + governance were reset to empty after all tests; continuity 'w-ui-test' was deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 2093 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. The engine-runtime block (~lines 1876-2027, ~150 lines) is a well-scoped unit that could be moved to backend/routers/engines.py (owner dep + /runtime, /execute, /chain, /flow, /policy, /governance, /diagnostics, /identity, /continuity, /rules) without any behaviour change.

engine_owner() rejects anonymous with 401 but non-admin logged-in with 403 — correct per spec; however the 403 message 'Admins only' doesn't hint that an X-Frasberg-Key header is also acceptable. Consider: 'Admins or a valid X-Frasberg-Key only'.

/api/engines/runtime response includes systems inline but systems have a separate GET /api/engines/systems endpoint — fine for convenience, but document on /developers (which currently has NO engine mention — intentional per spec, but a private admin cheat-sheet could help).

test parallelism: TestPolicyGovernance.test_policy_blocks_action and TestExecute.test_continuity_persist_and_delete both act on engine='mind' for owner=admin:admin.tester@luchiiapp.com concurrently when pytest-xdist is enabled. Not a product bug but tests are flaky under -n auto. Consider marking engine-mutating tests with pytest-xdist's @pytest.mark.serial or using distinct engines per test.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 sequential; 16/17 under parallel xdist due to admin+mind shared-state race, not a product bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — redirect, hidden-public, admin /status engine runtime + systems all green

seed_data_creation: Tests created transient continuities (w-test-*, w-ui-test); all deleted. Policy and governance (owner + global) toggled during tests but reset to empty [] at end. One non-admin user registered per session (nonadmin_<hex>@luchiiapp.com / Plain1234!) — safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: run `pytest backend/tests/test_engines_runtime_iter61.py -v -o addopts=''` (bypass xdist in pytest.ini) to avoid the admin+mind owner-level race between policy and continuity tests. All /api/engines/* routes live in server.py 1876-2027 behind engine_owner() dep (admin JWT OR platform key). Frontend EngineRuntime embed is admin-only on /status; signed-out users see engine-status-denied. The /engines route still exists as a React Navigate replace → /status (SEO-safe redirect, not a server 301). Do NOT exercise /api/gpu-admin/aws/start or image/video/3D generation.
